build_watermark_solver: build a WatermarkSolver instance from a DictConfig to train audio watermarking models with adversarial losses
run_watermark_training_step: run a single training step on an audio batch to compute watermark detection and adversarial losses
load_watermark_model_from_checkpoint: load a pretrained WatermarkModel from a checkpoint path or dora signature for inference
evaluate_watermark_detection: evaluate watermark detection accuracy, localization mIoU, and audio quality metrics like PESQ and STOI
compute_bit_accuracy: compute the bit accuracy between decoded watermark bits and the original embedded message
